hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *.env|*.dev.vars|*package-lock.json) echo "Blocked: $f is protected (secrets or npm-managed lock file). Edit it by hand or via npm." >&2; exit 2;; esac

f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *'\src\'*.js|*/src/*.js) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { out=$(npm test --silent 2>&1) || { printf "%s\n" "$out" | tail -40 >&2; exit 2; }; };; esac
